Build against API version v1 (sprint S21 fact; the v2..v40 values belong to earlier sprints S01-S20 and do not govern) with base path AX-25930 and error format AX-78362, which match repo/api.py.

Use the security team's JWT bearer tokens (RS256) for all user traffic; it governs over the customer's X-Api-Key request. Globex's request for a long-lived API key is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred and may be offered later only as a separate, scoped, revocable machine-to-machine credential for non-interactive scripts after security review.

Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key). S13 also has an earlier JWT auth_method fact; the X-Core-Key fact is the API-key header decision, so it governs.

Adopt the updated api_version (v2) from the researcher's S21 fact as the governing API version; older api_version facts for other subjects (S01-S20) are not for this sprint's subject and do not govern.

Approve the CRUD spec: API version v2. Auth facts conflict (researcher: JWT RS256; planner: API key in X-Api-Key); the planner's later auth choice governs. Code settings govern over memory where they differ (db.engine is AX-50215 in code vs AX-82757 in memory).

Reject the spec: api_version v2 is consistent, but the code returns auth.token_ttl AX-92098 and db.engine AX-50215 while memory records AX-46764 and AX-82757, and S21 has two conflicting auth_method facts (JWT RS256 vs API key in X-Api-Key). Reconcile before approval.
